ember_1.name: Kethra
ember_1.fall_text: The fire stopped at the edge of town. Its forges never went out.

ember_2.name: Brazier Hold
ember_2.fall_text: Ashwick is dead, and his cage is open.

ember_4.name: Pyrrhenhall
ember_4.fall_text: Ignar is awake, and the mountain's fire is his again.

storm_2.name: Highwind
storm_2.fall_text: Vholt is broken. Kaela Stormrider rides with us.

storm_3.name: Tarrow's Rest
storm_3.fall_text: The horses are safe in their pens.

storm_4.name: Aurvanis
storm_4.fall_text: Aurath is awake, and the sky is moving again.

nature_1.name: Fernholt
nature_1.fall_text: Its people are back in the branches.

nature_2.name: Elderhollow
nature_2.fall_text: Mother Briar is silent. Sylvaine Thornwhisper fights with us.

nature_3.name: Thornwall
nature_3.fall_text: The thorns round its trees lie still again.

nature_4.name: Sylvanmere
nature_4.fall_text: Elowen is awake, and the forest is quiet again.

water_2.name: Reedhaven
water_2.fall_text: The Saltmother is dead. Mirelle and forty children walked out of the ice.

water_3.name: Glasswater
water_3.fall_text: The lake froze over again behind the last of the drowned.

water_4.name: Pearlhaven
water_4.fall_text: Thalassa is awake, and the sea is freezing over.

earth_1.name: Dustmark
earth_1.fall_text: The rockslide broke on its walls.

earth_2.name: The Kharum Terraces
earth_2.fall_text: Gorrath is dead. Gorrim Stonebeard fights with us.

earth_3.name: Mesa Kharn
earth_3.fall_text: The quarried dead never reached the mesa.

earth_4.name: Grundhallow
earth_4.fall_text: Orrok is awake, and the stone lies still.

void_2.name: Vesperhold
void_2.fall_text: The Pale Vesper is dead. Corvin is free.

void_3.name: Twinmoor
void_3.fall_text: The shades are gone from its moor.

void_4.name: Umbrael
void_4.fall_text: Nyxara is awake. All six Wardens are free.

converge_1.name: Crossmere
converge_1.fall_text: Cassivane has fallen back, and left his daughter behind.

converge_2.name: The Lumen Gate
converge_2.fall_text: Solenne's outer wall is down. The other five still stand.

converge_3.name: Solenne
converge_3.fall_text: The Heartstone is safe, and the sun is up.

movements.name: The Long Siege
movements.objective: Hold the camp until his army is spent

movements.name: The High King
movements.objective: Break Vael-Orrun in all three of his forms

movements.name: The Turning
movements.objective: Muster the army and bring down Nhal Vorath
